description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView component that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface. It formats log entries, including priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and displays them in the UI, supporting chaining with other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode to display formatted log messages received from other LogNode instances. Supports chaining and thread-safe UI updates.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data based on priority, tag, message, and Throwable, and updates the LogView UI. Also forwards the log to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings and delimiters if the string is not null.
